fields: h, intro, items [{t, d, hold}]. A step's marks follow its place in the order; hold names who signs and labels the sheet's signature boxes (first hold: the left box, second: the right).
best_for: RevisionSheet tells a document review cycle on one document: a paper sheet stays pinned beside the steps and takes each step's marks as the step reaches the middle of the screen (comments, answered comments and a struck draft tag, signatures, recorded data, the current revision), its revision block filling one row per step.

items.d: Issued at its stage, numbered; your team comments within [standard review period, working days].
We answer each comment in a log that stays with the document, then reissue.
Your quality unit approves protocols before execution, specifications at their design gate.
Executed records carry raw data and both parties' signatures; drawings reissued as built.
The register lists every current revision; anything open is a punch list item.
